title: Node
description: A single location within a region — the unit of the fog-of-war node graph (FR-MAP-01). Static definition only: live per-node memory (searchPct, damage, corpses, noise, fog-of-war discovery, ...) lives in GameState.nodes, seeded from this definition at run start. Routes are the undirected edges of the graph; the engine's map integrity check requires them to be symmetric and the whole region to be connected from its single start node.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

id.description: Stable content id of the form node.<region-slug>.<node-slug>, e.g. "node.rivermouth.transit-plaza". Referenced by id from GameState (never embedded).

regionId.description: Id of the region this node belongs to (FR-MAP-01 — locations grouped into regions).

name.description: Player-facing display name (ICU MessageFormat string, LOCALIZATION §13).

description.description: Short flavor description shown when the node is scouted or entered (ICU MessageFormat string).

adjacent.description: Node ids directly reachable by one travel step (the graph's edges). Must be symmetric (if A lists B, B lists A) — enforced by the engine's map integrity check, not the schema.

start.description: True on exactly one node per shipped region set — where a new run begins. The engine rejects a set with zero or many start nodes.

claimable.description: True if this node can be claimed as a safehouse (FR-MAP-06). A claimed node can later be lost; claim state itself lives in GameState, not here.

notes.description: Author commentary. JSON has no comments (ADR-0002); use this field.

walkers.description: Bodies loitering here at run start — seeds an avoidable encounter at this node (FR-CBT-01, T15). Live count lives in GameState.nodes; omit for a quiet node (defaults to 0). Since T75 each entry of zombieTypes takes one of these bodies and the rest are plain walkers, so a node with two bodies and two listed types seeds one of each (not two of the most dangerous). If zombieTypes is LONGER than this count, every listed type still gets a body and the seeded total exceeds it — an authored type is never dropped.

kind.description: Location kind — selects the loot plausibility table for searches here (FR-ECO-02, T17). Defaults to generic when absent.

richness.description: How deep this particular building's stock is, as a PERCENTAGE of the ordinary yield for its region (FR-ECO-02, T84). 100 is an ordinary place of its kind and is the default when omitted; below it a place already stripped or never worth much; above it the pharmacy at the end of the block nobody got to. This is the node's only contribution to its own loot beyond the live searchPct — without it the yield cap has exactly one value per region and two nodes of the same kind in the same district are arithmetically identical. It scales the region's term only, never the picked-over penalty, and is clamped by what the region actually has left, so it redistributes a district's finite stock rather than adding to it. The multiply is gated on SOME node in the set authoring it, so a set that omits it everywhere computes the pre-T84 cap exactly.

roomSlots.description: How many rooms this building can hold (T85 - FR-SHL-04 - GDD XI). Optional; the whole room-slot layer is gated on some node in the set authoring it, so an omitting set keeps the unbounded rooms array. Read from the graph, never stored.

zombieTypes.description: Distinct zombie type ids present at this node (FR-CBT-07, T25). Since T75 each seeds one BODY in the node's roster (see walkers); NodeState.zombieTypes is then derived from that roster, so a type clears from the node when its last body is put down.
